title: Senior technical lead (platform modernization & ai systems) - remote latam
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior technical lead (platform modernization & ai systems) - remote latam em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Company Braintrust is a global talent network that connects top independent professionals with leading companies for high-quality, flexible work. We help organizations hire skilled talent faster while giving professionals access to vetted opportunities with innovative teams. Job description Senior Technical Lead Platform Modernization & AI Systems Type - Full-Time Location- Remote Reports To - VP of Product Level - Senior / Tech Lead About the Role We run a marketing agency serving 20+ active clients on a Word Press and Kadence-based platform. It works — and it’s actively serving customers — but we’ve outgrown it. We’re moving toward a Laravel + Filament central hub that gives us multi-tenant control, reliable data ingestion, and AI-assisted content workflows. This is not a greenfield project, and it’s not a quick one. It’s a deliberate, multi-phase migration that will unfold over months — with real clients on the line the entire time. You will be responsible for keeping production stable while progressively building the system that replaces it. The person we’re looking for doesn’t just know how to build the destination. They understand where we’re coming from, how to get from here to there without dropping anything, and how to do it as a small team with limited overhead — prioritizing the right work at the right time. Where We Are Today Current Stack - Serving customers in production today Word Press Multisite Kadence Theme / Blocks CSV-based content ingestion 20+ active client accounts Target State - Migrated progressively — no big bang Laravel + Filament central hub Multi-tenant architecture Queue-based ingestion pipelines AI-assisted content workflows How We're Getting There This role owns the migration path. We expect a phased approach that keeps clients live at every step: Phase 1 - Audit & Design Assess current WP/Kadence architecture, content structures, and CSV workflows. Design multi-tenant data model and migration strategy. Phase 2 - Parallel Build Develop Laravel/Filament hub alongside existing WP system. No client disruption — new platform builds in parallel. Phase 3 - Pilot Migration Migrate 1–2 internal or low-risk clients. Validate ingestion pipelines, environment tooling, and content parity. Phase 4 - AI Layer Introduce AI-assisted content workflows with structured prompts, brand voice configs, and human-in-the-loop approval. Phase 5 - Progressive Rollout Migrate remaining clients in cohorts. Maintain WP fallback until each client is fully validated on new platform. What You'll Own The migration strategy — how we move from Word Press/Kadence to Laravel/Filament without service disruption Laravel + Filament hub development: client environment management, content ops, data ingestion Multi-tenant architecture design and implementation CSV/data ingestion pipelines: queue-based, fault-tolerant, and auditable (replacing current WP ingest) AI-assisted content workflows: LLM API integration, prompt design, brand voice config, approval flows Word Press environment stewardship during transition — keeping 20+ client sites stable The technical roadmap, with real input into sequencing and priorities Day-to-day technical leadership of the existing team — supporting active client website builds on WP/Kadence while the new platform takes shape Establishing and enforcing development standards, code review practices, and build processes that work across both the current WP environment and the emerging Laravel platform Defining and implementing repeatable processes for new client site builds — templating, onboarding checklists, handoff documentation, and quality gates Mentoring and guiding the existing development team through the transition — building their capability on the new stack without stalling current client delivery What We're Looking For Platform & Migration Experience Proven experience migrating live production systems — not just greenfield builds Deep Word Press knowledge: content architecture, plugin ecosystem, multisite, data structures Familiarity with Kadence theme/blocks — enough to audit and replicate frontend behavior 5+ years of Laravel; hands-on Filament or equivalent admin panel experience Ability to design multi-tenant systems with a clear opinion on shared vs. isolated data models Reliability Engineering Experience building background job pipelines (Laravel Horizon, Redis, queues) Thinks about rollback, failover, and data integrity from day one Knows how to run two systems in parallel and cut over safely AI & Automation Production LLM API integration (Anthropic, Open AI, or similar) — not just experiments Treats prompt engineering as a design discipline tied to content schemas Has built or designed human-in-the-loop workflows for AI-generated content Understands cost controls, caching, and token budgeting at scale Defines and enforces quality standards for AI-assisted code generation, including review strategies, automated checks, and prompt constraints to prevent low-quality outputs from entering production Leadership & Process Leads by doing — sets the technical standard through their own work and brings the team along rather than delegating from a distance Implements process where it doesn’t exist — build workflows, review checklists, deployment standards — without letting process become overhead Keeps the team unblocked on active builds while managing their own migration work — knows how to context-switch without dropping either thread Slows down on ambiguous problems before writing code — and creates clarity for others, not just themselves Communicates tradeoffs clearly to both the team and non-technical stakeholders — can translate technical risk into business terms and vice versa Treats documentation, system design, and process definition as core leadership deliverables — not afterthoughts Comfortable owning decisions in a lean environment — with real accountability Nice to Have Experience with headless or decoupled frontend architectures Familiarity with Laravel Forge, Ploi, or Docker-based environment provisioning Background inside a marketing or digital agency Experience managing white-label or multi-brand Saa S platforms What This Is Not This is not a ticket-closing role, and it’s not a clean-slate build. You’ll be navigating a live system with real customers while building its replacement — and doing it without a large team behind you. There’s no dedicated QA function, no army of developers to delegate to, and no big-bang go-live at the end. The migration will happen in stages over an extended timeline, and progress will be measured in stability and incremental momentum, not sprints. If you need a fully resourced team, a scoped backlog, or external validation at every step to do your best work, this isn’t the right fit. We want someone who treats migration risk as a design constraint, works well with limited support, and builds accordingly. Why This Role You'll own the architecture of a system that directly determines how 20+ clients are served Real AI integration work with production stakes — not a proof of concept A clear mandate: modernize without breaking what's working A small, focused team where your decisions carry real weight — and real ownership comes with it

title: Ai evaluation engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ai evaluation engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About First Ignite First Ignite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at First Ignite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the Open AI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Open AI Evals, Deep Eval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, Lang Graph, Open AI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

Migration ExperienceProven experience migrating live production systems — not just greenfield buildsDeep Word Press knowledge: content architecture, plugin ecosystem, multisite, data Empresa está contratando Fiscal de obra - supervisão de obras de subestação e linhas de transmissão/distribuição em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

A QUADRANTE Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1100 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes. O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia a dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades. Objetivo do Cargo Atuar no acompanhamento e fiscalização das obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição, garantindo que os serviços executados estejam em conformidade com os projetos, especificações técnicas, requisitos de qualidade, segurança, prazo e procedimentos estabelecidos pelo cliente e pela engenharia. Principais Responsabilidades Acompanhar diariamente as atividades de campo em obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição; Fiscalizar a execução dos serviços civis, eletromecânicos, montagem elétrica, lançamento de cabos, estruturas metálicas, equipamentos e comissionamento; Verificar conformidade dos serviços executados com projetos, memoriais, especificações técnicas, normas aplicáveis e procedimentos construtivos; Realizar inspeções de qualidade e acompanhamento da produtividade das frentes de serviço; Identificar desvios técnicos, interferências e não conformidades, propondo ações corretivas e acompanhando sua implementação; Acompanhar cronogramas executivos e reportar avanços físicos da obra; Validar medições de serviços executados e apoiar o controle de quantitativos; Participar de reuniões de obra, alinhamentos técnicos e interface com contratadas, fiscalização e cliente; Emitir relatórios de acompanhamento de obra, registros fotográficos e relatórios de não conformidade; Apoiar o controle documental de campo, incluindo desenhos revisados, procedimentos e registros de qualidade; Acompanhar atividades críticas, testes, energizações e liberações operacionais; Garantir cumprimento dos requisitos de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente durante a execução das atividades. Informações adicionais É essencial que o candidato tenha disponibilidade para viagens. Vaga para atuar em todo Brasil, principalmente em Salvador - BA, com viagens constantes. Requisitos Formação técnica em Eletrotécnica, Eletromecânica, Civil ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em fiscalização ou acompanhamento de obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição; Conhecimento emmontagem eletromecânica, obras civis, equipamentos de subestação e sistemas elétricos; Conhecimento deleitura e interpretação de projetos e documentos técnicos; Familiaridade com normas técnicas e procedimentos do setor elétrico; Disponibilidadepara atuação integral em campo e deslocamentos. Competências Desejáveis Boa comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento em campo; Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo; Capacidade de identificar desvios e acompanhar soluções técnicas; Disciplina no reporte de informações e controle de atividades; Comprometimentocom qualidade, prazo e segurança da obra.

Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Clinical Study Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Summary  The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities   Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.  Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.  Education and Experience  Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.  Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.  Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.). . Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Account Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Account Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments. You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success. Specifically, your role will involve:  Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor. Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services. Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions. Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts. Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions. Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts. Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments. Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management. Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.  The ideal profile    We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions. Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth. Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.   Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.  Next steps in the process ✅  First Interview:  A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:  A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Final Step:  A proposition for us to start working together!  What’s in it for you  Remote Work Environment:  Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:  We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:  As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:  Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun  . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
